♡ October 29 ♡

A little letter for you 💌

Some feelings are easier to write down than say out loud.

Dear Achu, ♡

Happy birthday to someone who has become so special to me. I may not have a big gift to give you, but I wanted to make something with my own effort, just for you.

I still remember the moment I told you how I felt and you said “yes.” For a second, it felt like a dream. That memory will always be precious to me.

I hope this new year of your life brings you happiness, good health, confidence, and beautiful memories. Keep smiling, keep being yourself, and never forget how special you are.

Thank you for being you, Achu. I hope this little page makes you smile today. ♡

With love,
Anshu ♡
